title: AVR status register
description: SREG, the 8-bit status register of an AVR microcontroller such as the ATmega328P: bit 7 at the left, each flag named by its letter, readable and writable, zero at reset.
caption: After the ATmega328P datasheet's status register (SREG). Every bit is 0 at reset.

fields.note: Global Interrupt Enable: set by SEI, cleared by CLI.
Bit Copy Storage: the source and destination of BST and BLD.
